t: What Mechanical Design Optimization Database Is All About
title: What Mechanical Design Optimization Database Is All About
description: Design optimization searches variables for the best objective under constraints: minimize weight subject to stress < allowable, or maximize efficiency within size. Gradient methods (fast, local), genetic algorithms (global, slow), topology optimization (material only where needed — the organic-looking brackets).
